meta.description:
In Rondônia, Brazil, one highway was enough. Side roads branched off, settlers followed, and each branch cleared a strip of rainforest. From orbit the pattern looks like a fishbone.

Watch our planet change in seconds. Accelerated geographic shifts, urban growth and climate overviews from a clean satellite perspective.

📍 Rondônia, Brazil · 1984 → 2024
🎬 Stylized satellite reconstruction based on real-world deforestation patterns.
